facts.fact: The 7th ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries (CPL-26) was hosted in Abuja by Nigeria's communications ministry and concluded on 2026-07-24, with Nigeria assuming the chairmanship of the Conference for the next cycle.

Member states, Nigeria among them as host, adopted the 2026 Abuja Declaration on Meaningful Connectivity at the ATU conference on 2026-07-24, committing governments to technology-neutral regulation, spectrum and fibre access, cybersecurity and affordability.
